title: console: hide the add / remove controls for permission sets outside a delegated security admin's scope (split from #34700)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: split from #34700 by area `o2-I`'s premise reading on `origin/main` `a34eb071` (item ③; the server half stays on #34700, see its premise comment 6943935258). Dedupe: `AssignedUsersSection delegated scope controls`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p1 (inherits #34700) · domain:ui

## 维护者速读

- 现象：委派安全管理员在用户的权限集分配处，能看到并点「添加 / 移除」超出自己委派范围的权限集(例如 admin_full_access、官员集合)。服务端已经拒绝(403 DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION),但界面先让人点、再报错。
- 为什么要修：三员分立下，安全管理员不该被引导去做一定会被拒的操作。
- 需要你做的：无(分诊定级)。

## Change

In the console's permission-set assignment UI (`AssignedUsersSection` and the add picker), hide or disable add / remove for sets outside the caller's delegated scope, reading the same scope the server's `delegated-admin-gate` judges (no second copy of the rule in the client). A pin per control.

## Done when

A delegated security admin sees no add / remove control for a set outside their scope; an unrestricted admin sees them as today.
